candidate_workaround: Split broad source-file inspection into bounded UTF-8 reads and verify repository state separately after any wrapper timeout.
failure_signature: A combined read-only inspection of two large predecessor scripts exceeded its wrapper timeout and returned no attributable content.
recurrence_guard: Read one bounded file segment per command and audit HEAD plus clean state before continuing after a timeout.
rollback: Give the timed-out inspection zero evidence credit, retain it, and stop if repository state cannot be attributed read-only.
scope_boundary: Same-owner read-only workflow recovery only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bounded predecessor-script inspection after wrapper timeout
trigger_preconditions: A read-only inspection combines multiple large predecessor files under one wrapper deadline.
